run_use_autovisualizer_if_present: run the use_autovisualizer_if_present hook to render a node with an active autovisualizer
create_IPythonVisualization: create an IPythonVisualization wrapping a display object for rich HTML or figure rendering
create_VisualizationFromTreescopePart: create a VisualizationFromTreescopePart with a custom treescope rendering part
create_ChildAutovisualizer: create a ChildAutovisualizer to scope a different autovisualizer for a subtree
set_active_autovisualizer: set the active_autovisualizer context variable to enable custom visualization hooks
